title: Complete Adventures of Feluda Vol.2

vibeProfile.oneLine: Volume two of the complete adventures of Feluda.

summary: The second volume of the complete adventures of Feluda continues Satyajit Ray's beloved detective series, with more ingenious cases solved by the sharp-eyed sleuth alongside his cousin Topshe and the comic thriller writer Jatayu. Ranging across India's cities, hills and historic sites, the mysteries combine clever plotting with warmth, wit and a strong sense of place. A treasured classic of Indian crime writing for readers young and old.
whyReadIt: More adventures of Ray's beloved detective Feluda, clever cases with warmth, wit and a strong sense of place.

funFacts.text: The Feluda stories are set in vividly described real locations across India.
